propositions: reconcile-bridge-canary.yml contains ~200 lines of production logic in YAML run-blocks (staleness classification, alert-ticket lifecycle state machines) that is untestable, unlintable by ruff, and a high-defect surface

Classification and alert-lifecycle logic (with branchy decision logic and ${{ }} expressions interleaved) should migrate to Python module scripts/canary_bridge.py with unit tests while preserving CAS push loops in YAML as verbatim-tested exceptions

check-heartbeat, heartbeat-alert, check-binding-drift, and binding-drift-alert subcommands must preserve existing error handling dispositions: alert-write failures fail loud, dedup finds fail-soft to empty, and bridge-fsck exit-1-with-valid-JSON is treated as drift signal not error
Thin YAML steps (env + single-command invocations) replace logic-bearing run-blocks; DRY_RUN re-checked in Python subcommands as defense-in-depth against dropped `if:` guards
Anti-rot test must pin canary wiring (workflow invokes subcommands, flush loop remains verbatim, no new logic-bearing run-blocks); class guard assertion re-pointed to module runtime behavior
